title: Production AI Service with Tracing & Rollout Controls
description: Ship an AI service that would survive on-call: structured traces per request, Prometheus-compatible metrics, health checks, deterministic deployment flags for progressive rollout and rollback, and a documented failure-handling runbook.
learningObjectives: Instrument requests with structured, correlated traces
Expose operational metrics (latency, errors, token usage) in a standard format
Control rollout with feature flags and staged percentages
Write and exercise a rollback runbook

milestones.title: Typed AI service
milestones.objective: Serve a model/LLM endpoint with typed requests, auth placeholder, and rate limiting.

milestones.title: Structured tracing
milestones.objective: Every request produces a trace with request ID, stage timings, token counts, and error classification.
milestones.expectedOutput: Sample traces exported in a standard format.

milestones.title: Metrics + dashboards
milestones.objective: Expose latency/error/saturation metrics; provide a dashboard config that renders them.
milestones.expectedOutput: Metrics endpoint + dashboard file in repo.

milestones.title: Rollout / rollback controls
milestones.objective: Implement staged rollout (percentage or shadow) and a documented one-command rollback, verified for real.
milestones.expectedOutput: Rollback runbook demonstrated in the report.

categories.minimumExpectation: Trace for a failing request is diagnosable
Doc'd rollback works in a demo

architecture: request → traced handler → model/LLM adapter → response
constraints: No code-execution of user submitted input
Provider keys only via env refs
hints: Break something on purpose (bad dependency, wrong port) and make sure the dashboards and traces tell the story an on-call engineer needs
